prompt: LruCache evicts by insertion order instead of least-recently-used order. A successful get and updating an existing key must refresh that key before the next eviction. Keep FIFO-style key iteration from least to most recent, and keep capacity zero stable.

graders.name: fail_to_pass
graders.cmd: javac -encoding UTF-8 -d out src/*.java verify/FailToPass.java && java -cp out FailToPass

graders.name: pass_to_pass
graders.cmd: javac -encoding UTF-8 -d out src/*.java verify/PassToPass.java && java -cp out PassToPass
